summary.name: IINA
summary.one_liner: IINA is a free, open-source media player for macOS built on mpv, with a native macOS interface and plugin support.
use_cases: watching local video files on a Mac
playing media with native macOS gestures
using Picture in Picture while working
summary.what_it_does: IINA is a media player designed specifically for macOS, with an interface meant to match the system. It supports trackpad gestures, media controls, Picture in Picture, and Live Text. Users can adjust its controls, sidebars, and other interface items. Plugins can add subtitle sources, video tools, and new interfaces created by the community. The project is built on mpv and states it includes no tracking or telemetry.
notable: Built on the mpv media player engine
Open source and maintained by its community, with no tracking or telemetry
Plugin system for subtitle sources, video tools and interfaces
Native macOS design with trackpad gestures and Live Text
caveats: Requires macOS 12.0, or macOS 11.0 for Intel Macs
